attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Illinois state income tax per Form IL-1040. Illinois uses a flat tax rate of 4.95% (2025) with personal exemptions of $2,775 per person. Starting with federal AGI, adds state bond interest, subtracts retirement income, applies personal exemptions, and calculates tax at flat rate.

initial_action.action_postfix: "ILLINOIS FORM IL-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 local@ num_people > result.agi /result.il_agi xdef

condition_details.condition_postfix: job.taxpayers arraysize job.dependents arraysize + local@ num_people > num_people 1 >=

action_details.action_description: Calculate Illinois AGI, apply exemptions, calculate tax at 4.95%
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi local@ il_retirement_subtraction > 0 local@ state_bond_addition > { dup type income_type > income_type "pension" streq income_type "ira_distribution" streq or income_type "social_security" streq or if dup gross_amount il_retirement_subtraction f+ local@ il_retirement_subtraction > endif } job.incomes forall il_retirement_subtraction 0 f> if " Subtract Retirement Income: -$" il_retirement_subtraction cvs strconcat " (IL allows full subtraction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.il_agi il_retirement_subtraction f- /result.il_agi xdef endif " Illinois AGI: $" result.il_agi cvs strconcat " (Form IL-1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto num_people il_personal_exemption f* /result.il_exemption_total xdef " Personal Exemptions: " num_people cvs strconcat " × $" strconcat il_personal_exemption cvs strconcat " = $" strconcat result.il_exemption_total cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.il_agi result.il_exemption_total f- 0 fmax /result.il_taxable_income xdef " Illinois Taxable Income: $" result.il_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Exemptions)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.il_taxable_income il_tax_rate f* /result.il_tax xdef " Illinois Tax (4.95%): $" result.il_tax cvs strconcat " (Form IL-1040 Line 13)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

" Illinois AGI: $" result.il_agi cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.il_agi 0 fmax /result.il_taxable_income xdef result.il_taxable_income il_tax_rate f* /result.il_tax xdef " Illinois Tax (4.95%): $" result.il_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: Illinois flat tax 4.95% with personal exemptions
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Illinois flat tax 4.95% with personal exemptions per Form IL-1040"
